summary: D-MARKET Electronic Services & Trading (Hepsiburada) filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing includes unaudited financial statements restated under IAS 29 for hyperinflationary economies, with GMV up 28.4% to TRY 57.8 billion and revenue up 22.9%. Active customers reached 11.6 million. There are no special-situation elements; it is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer on NASDAQ. No acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other corporate events are disclosed.
